title: Meeting a new neighbour
instructions: Tom yeni komşusu Lin ile tanışıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; iş, aile ve evcil hayvanlara dikkat et.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Hello! I'm Tom. I live at number twelve.

script.speaker: lin
script.text: Hi Tom. I'm Lin. I'm in number fourteen. We're new here.

script.speaker: lin
script.text: I'm from China, but my husband is from Canada.

script.speaker: lin
script.text: I'm a doctor at the hospital. My husband is a teacher.

script.speaker: lin
script.text: Yes, one daughter. She is six. And we have a cat.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Oh, I have a dog. His name is Rex. He is very friendly.

script.speaker: lin
script.text: My daughter loves dogs! Is there a park near here?

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Yes, there is a big park at the end of the street.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: No problem. Have a nice day!

questions.feedback: Lin on dört (fourteen) numarada. On iki Tom'un evi.

questions.evidence: but my husband is from Canada.

questions.feedback: Lin hastanede doktor; öğretmen olan eşi.
questions.evidence: I'm a doctor at the hospital.
